notes.title: Full Steam Deck and Linux Support
notes.content: [h2]Hello, friends![/h2][p][/p][p]We’re excited to announce that the game now offers [b]full support for Steam Deck and Linux![/b][/p][p]Steam Deck users can enjoy dedicated graphics presets designed to provide a smooth and comfortable experience right out of the box.[/p][p]It’s the perfect time to try the game on your favorite device![/p][p]We’re also actively working on the macOS version — stay tuned for updates![/p][p]To download the latest updates for Steam Deck, go to the game’s properties, open the “Compatibility” section, select “Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool,” and choose “Steam Linux Runtime” from the drop-down list.[/p][p]P.S. notes.title: About Anti-Cheat and Mods
notes.content: [h2][b]About Anti-Cheat and Mods[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Steam Deck & Linux[/b][/p][p]The team is preparing a fix for this temporary issue in the coming days.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Anti-Cheat[/b][/p][p]Anti-cheat is not designed to block players or their accounts—it exists to prevent game hacking. Of course, if you try to run the game with Cheat Engine enabled, you won’t be able to play, but your account won’t be banned. You simply won’t be able to launch the game until you close Cheat Engine. Don’t fear anti-cheat—it’s not your enemy. It protects you in multiplayer and poses no threat to honest players.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Mods[/b][/p][p]As we’ve already announced, visual mods such as texture replacements, car model swaps (FBX), and ReShade presets are not penalized in our game. Regarding broken mods—we’ve improved mod support in update 1.7.0 by changing the car mesh storage system. This means mod creators won’t have to update their mods after version 1.7.0.[/p][p][/p][p][b]ReShade[/b][/p][p]Unfortunately, ReShade support is currently suspended, but the team is actively looking into bringing it back. For now, we recommend removing ReShade, as it may cause serious graphical artifacts or game crashes.[/p]

tags.bug: The team is preparing a fix for this temporary issue in the coming days.

Unfortunately, ReShade support is currently suspended, but the team is actively looking into bringing it back. For now, we recommend removing ReShade, as it may cause serious graphical artifacts or game crashes.

notes.title: Update 1.6.0
notes.content:
[b]What’s up, drivers! 1.6.0 Update of CarX Street PC is available.[/b]

In the new version

[b]New Features:[/b]

Inventory added: your inventory allows you to store, install, and sell the parts you acquire as you play the game. Your engines and transmissions will also be moved to your inventory when you swap cars.

Multiplayer user rooms added: you can now create a public room in multiplayer mode. You can also create rules for the room - mono- or multi-class, front- or rear-wheel drive, day or night - it's all up to you.

Prototype parts added: take your tuning to the next level! These parts will allow you to get every last drop of performance out of your cars. Prototype-class parts can be found in Elite Club Races.

[b]Improvements:[/b]

Phone calls added before and after races with the Club Bosses of Wild Juniors, Union Underground, Burnout Rangers, Kanjo Spirit, and Street Hunters.

Boss and underboss cars now have new looks! Each car has its own style that highlights its club's unique personality.

Club postgame progress enhanced: leveling up in the postgame now earns you new car parts.
Reward for Club Bosses and Underbosses enhanced. Now when you win against them, you can get parts for your cars. If you already completed the clubs, don't worry - when you enter the game, you'll automatically get all Street Packs for clubs in your inventory.

New cars earned for completing clubs: the cars you earn are now more interesting and compelling. If you've already completed the clubs that unlock the new cars, don't worry - they'll be added to your account automatically next time you log in.

StreetNET League cars improved.

New StreetNET League races added for the mountain region and Sunset Speedway racetrack. New cars have also been added in the new races.

Enhanced mod support: community-created mods will no longer be deleted or broken when the game is updated.

Performance improved.
In-game cameras improved.
Racing wheel force feedback improved; new settings added.
Club Race difficulty adjusted.
Advanced smoke effect improved.
Car behavior improved.
Cost of tuning cars reduced.
Clutch-type differentials upgraded.
Option to turn off counter steering on sticks added.
Support for trigger vibrations on Xbox One and Xbox Series X controllers added.
TAA Upscaling resolution scaling system added.
TAA anti-aliasing improved; ghosting effect from cars removed.

[b]Fixes:[/b]

The difficulty level descriptions in the settings menu no longer cause the game to hang.
Smoke under the wheels of boss cars in cutscenes now displays properly.
Boss cutscene audio fixed.
Radial menu mouse behavior fixed.
Loading screen logo fixed.
SI5 and DX7 prototype engines from Drift Cars add-on fixed.
Dynostand settings save window fixed.
TCL ECU icons fixed.
White tire trails fixed.
Collision sound effects fixed.
Player list in global chat now displays properly.
Negative and abnormally low transmission loss values fixed.
Adjustment of the steering angle on the 63C fixed.
Front-wheel drive assist for keyboard fixed. Now your car turns faster.

[b]Enjoy![/b]

notes.title: New public test release version of 1.6.0 update!
notes.content:
What's up, drivers! 
New CarX Street PC 1.6.0 public test version is now available! 
What's new: 

[b]New Features:[/b]

- Added Inventory: Now you can store, install, and sell parts that you acquire throughout the game. Additionally, engines and transmissions will now be moved to the inventory when swapped.
- Prototype Parts introduced! These parts allow for extreme tuning, pushing your cars to their maximum potential. Prototype-class parts can be found in elite club races.

[b]Improvements:[/b]

- Pre- and post-race phone calls with club bosses from Wild Juniors, Union Underground, Burnout Rangers, Kanjo Spirit, and Streethunters added.
- Bosses' and underbosses' cars now have a new look, each reflecting the unique style of their respective club.
- The post-progression system in clubs—reaching new post-progression levels now rewards you with car parts expanded.

notes.title: 1.0.5 Update
notes.content:
What's up drivers!
CarX Street PC 1.0.5 update is already available! 

What's new:

- A test drive feature has been added for cars, allowing you to test a car before purchasing it.
- The checkpoint system in leaderboards has been improved.
- The number of deliveries required to unlock higher-level deliveries has been reduced.
- The transmission system has been refined for the three starting cars: HC6, NX5, and DTS.
- Fixed the display of rewards when leveling up.
- The car paint material for car deliveries has been adjusted.
- The camera system has been improved, and camera settings have been added.
- Game security improved, infinite boost fixed.
- New music from ENSKA and PLAUDO has been added.

Please, note, that multiplayer and leaderboards mode are going to be available only for 1.0.5 players. If you've got a previous version of the game, please install this update. 

We want more players to receive rewards in leaderboard mode, so starting next week, the list of winning positions in all leaderboards will be expanded, and the rewards will become more substantial.

We would also like to announce that compensation has been provided to all players who completed the clubs before the in-game economy update, as well as to all players who encountered an issue with the Z40 car.

We are beginning to take action against dishonest players. All cars obtained by players through dishonest means have been replaced with "pumpkins" — yellow HC6s. 

Please note that continuing dishonest play will result in disconnection from the game’s online modes.

- The "Car Change" section of the phone menu now includes features for placing new cars in homes and selling cars;

In this mode, you will compete with your own cars to win a secret and unique one. 

The new mode will be available in 30 minutes after the update.

Additionally, we would like to clarify that we are aware that some players completed clubs before the in-game balance update and were unable to earn enough currency for comfortable gameplay.

Such players will receive compensation covering the difference between the previous and current balance versions. 
Compensation will be sent automatically in the near future.

Enjoy!
